paper_title: RedWhale An Adapted Korean LLM Through Efficient Continual Pretraining
caption: Token Ratio (TR).
model_annotation: The chart illustrates the token ratio across different categories, comparing three models: RedWhale, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base). The horizontal axis lists the categories PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG, while the vertical axis represents the token ratio, ranging from approximately 0 to 1.00. The bars are grouped by category, with each group consisting of three bars representing the three models, colored dark blue for RedWhale, light blue for EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and gray for SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0. The values for RedWhale range from 0.42 to 0.70, for EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 from 0.46 to 0.74, and for SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0, all values are consistently at 1.00. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and the gray bars for SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 are visually consistent across all categories. The chart provides a clear visual representation of the token ratio for each model across the different categories.
